subject.title: fix(media): apply SSRF guard to byteplus and runway generated video downloads

question: Should BytePlus and Runway generated-video artifact URLs move to the default-deny SSRF policy, with the existing models.providers.<id>.request.allowPrivateNetwork setting as the explicit upgrade path for private endpoints?
rationale: The implementation is consistent with merged sibling providers, but this is an intentional security-versus-upgrade compatibility choice for existing custom/private provider deployments and introduces an additive public provider-HTTP helper.

options.title: Adopt default-deny guarded downloads
options.body: Approve the shared helper and land the patch so provider-controlled private artifact URLs are blocked unless an operator explicitly opts in.

options.title: Preserve prior private-download behavior
options.body: Decline the default-deny change and define a different compatibility policy before merging, acknowledging that the current SSRF exposure remains.

recommendation.title: Adopt default-deny guarded downloads
recommendation.body: Approve the shared helper and land the patch so provider-controlled private artifact URLs are blocked unless an operator explicitly opts in.

likelyOwner.reason: Their recent merged provider work supplies the closest established request-policy and guarded-download precedent.
